studio.qr.split-note-ayah: A new clip with each ayah, changing in the pause between ayat. They play in the order you tapped them.
studio.qr.split-note-even: The clips share the reel equally, in the order you tapped them.
studio.qr.max-clips: Up to {n} clips. Tap a numbered clip to take it out.
studio.qr.modes-need-timings: This recitation has no word timings, so only the whole ayah can be shown (never guessed).
studio.qr.own-kept: Your text and layout choices stay when you change the vibe, and are remembered for the next reel.
studio.qr.ref-stays: The reference (e.g. Al-Baqarah · 2:255) always stays on the video. Only the Arabic surah name can be hidden.
studio.ed.reciter-ayah-only: Whole ayah on screen (no word timings)
studio.mk.logo-note: A PNG with a transparent background looks best. Kept on this device only.
studio.mk.too-big: That image is too large (over 8 MB).
studio.mk.unreadable: That image could not be read.
studio.ed.tail-note: Silent: no sound is added. The background, the reference and your mark keep going. You can also drag the first audio block or the end of the timeline.
studio.mk.drag-note: Drag your mark on the preview to move it along the top or the bottom.
studio.mk.keys-note: Add a keyframe, move the playhead, then drag your mark or change its size: it glides between keyframes along its strip.
studio.mk.keys-note-on: Drag your mark or change Size here at the playhead: a keyframe is set there. Size above is the largest it gets.
studio.mk.note: Your mark is remembered for your next reels. It keeps its own strip, so it never covers the ayah, the translation or the reference.
studio.ed.cover-note: Move the playhead to the frame you like and tap Use this frame. The video file carries it as its cover, and the export page gives you the image to pick as the cover in Instagram or TikTok.
studio.ed.set-each-silence-to-the-millisecond-t: Set each silence to the millisecond: tap or hold the steps, or type the seconds. The text moves with its words, and words are never cut.
studio.ed.add-another-scene-to-change-lengths: Add another scene to change lengths.
studio.ed.this-scene-is-a-photo-or-a-colour-pho: This scene is a photo or a colour. Photos move slowly on their own.
studio.ed.this-video-repeats-in-other-scenes-th: This video repeats in other scenes; they all use these settings.
studio.ed.background-videos-play-without-their-: Background videos play without their own sound.
studio.ed.a-mood-sets-the-text-effect-transitio: A mood sets the text effect, transition, colours, colour grade, darkening and pacing. Adjust anything after.
studio.ed.calm-effects-only-ink-reveal-and-ligh: Calm effects only. Ink reveal and light sweep move right to left on the Arabic.
studio.ed.transitions-play-between-scenes-add-a: Transitions play between scenes: add a second scene (the + in the timeline) to see them.
studio.ed.a-soft-shadow-keeps-the-text-readable: A soft shadow keeps the text readable on any background.
studio.ed.for-one-ayah-tap-its-audio-in-the-tim: For one ayah: tap its audio in the timeline, then drag its edges to trim silence or drag it to add a pause. Words are never cut.
studio.ed.what-the-text-does-in-the-pause-betwe: What the text does in the pause between ayat.
studio.ed.darkens-the-background-behind-the-tex: Darkens the background behind the text so it stays readable.
studio.ed.the-reference-e-g-al-fatiha-1-1-alway: The reference (e.g. Al-Fatiha · 1:1) always stays on screen.
studio.ed.keep-this-screen-open-while-the-video: Keep this screen open while the video is made on your device.
studio.ed.splitWhere: Move the playhead inside the scene (at least {s} s from its ends)
studio.ed.pickAdd: Tap a background to add it as a new scene at the end.
studio.ed.sceneMin: At least {s} s per scene. Snap to pauses does not apply here.
studio.ed.tapVideo: Tap the video to pick a colour
studio.ed.sc.oneAyah: One ayah: use Even split or Custom for more than one scene.
studio.ed.sc.perAyah: Each ayah gets the next scene; changes fall in the pause between ayat.
studio.ed.sc.perAyahRepeat: Each ayah gets the next scene (the list repeats when there are fewer scenes than ayat); changes fall in the pause between ayat.
studio.ed.sc.even: The scenes share the length of the reel equally.
studio.ed.sc.custom: Select a scene in the timeline: drag its edges to trim, drag it to reorder, or Split it at the playhead. Scenes always fill the reel (each at least 1 s).
